title: ai-sucks-butt/ai-sucks-butt
why_read: A joke repository with no real technical content beyond a star-collecting gimmick offers nothing of substance for a technical digest.
analysis: This repository appears to be a meme or joke project whose sole function is inviting people to star it if they dislike AI, with no actual code, tool, or technical contribution described. It has accumulated significant stars purely through social/meme virality rather than any engineering merit. There's nothing here for an engineer to learn from or apply.
